question: HD Kumaraswamy, who won from Mandya parliamentary seat in Karnataka in 2024 general elections and became Minister of Heavy Industries, belongs to which political party?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Janata Dal (S)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• H.D. Kumaraswamy is a senior leader of the **Janata Dal (Secular)** (JD(S)) and has served as the Chief Minister of Karnataka in the past.
 
• In the 2024 general elections, he contested from the **Mandya parliamentary seat** in Karnataka and secured a victory.
 
• Subsequently, he was appointed as the **Minister of Heavy Industries** in the Union Government.
 
• This marked a significant milestone for the JD(S), as the party secured representation in the central government, which is relatively rare for a regional party primarily focused on Karnataka.
